start: Gemini 3.6 Flash will be retired
source: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash will be retired on November 19, 2026. Starting on that date, API calls to Gemini 3.6 Flash will be automatically redirected to Gemini 3.8 Flash at the same price.

start: Zhipu AI GLM 5.2 is deprecated
source: Zhipu AI GLM 5.2 is deprecated and will be retired on February 4, 2027. GLM 5.3 is the recommended replacement.

start: Smart Routing (Beta) now routes only
source: Smart Routing now routes only subagents, not the first prompt. It costs up to 70% less in internal benchmarks and cuts p90 routing latency from 9 seconds to 2 seconds.

start: Defaults changed too.
source: The default model for the `anthropic` provider is now Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) instead of Claude Opus 4.8

start: Claude Code 2.1.321 made Claude Fable

start: Claude Code 2.1.323 added Code Mode
source: Removed the `subagentStatusLine` setting: subagent rows always use the default look, and settings files that still hold the key load as before

start: A bug report says the removal
source: `subagentStatusLine` was the **only** place in Claude Code where a user could see, per running subagent, at a glance: - its live context use against its own window - what it has spent so far (tokens and dollars) - its model **and** its reasoning effort

start: OpenCode v2.3.0 made subagents always run
source: Subagents now always run in the background, return their session ID immediately, and report results to their parent whenever they become idle.
